# Performance: the rewrite against C

Release builds, measured 2026-11-07T19:13:18Z to 2026-11-07T19:55:50Z on a 8-CPU aarch64 kvm machine (kernel 7.1.8-200.fc44.aarch64), the legs' samples interleaved; load average 1.74 before and 6.61 after. The rewrite at `f2d631373777`. Figures are medians; compare only builds measured on this machine, in one run of this script.


Both legs link one HTTP/3 build: ngtcp2 1.25.0 pic gnutls+wolfssl wolfssl-5.9.4 (inventory/measure/deps.py: `configure --disable-dependency-tracking --enable-lib-only --with-openssl --with-gnutls --with-wolfssl --with-pic`) from `/home/kov/Projects/curl/build/deps/ngtcp2`, the C legs its shared libraries and the Rust legs its static archives; nghttp3 1.18.0 (`/usr/lib64/libnghttp3.so.9.9.0`).

## scorecard

A run the scorecard reports errors for is left out of its cell's median and counted as failed in it. A requests run fails when a response is not a 200 or the tool exits with an error; with `--parallel`, Rust's tool exits with a transfer's failure where C's can forget it (DIVERGENCE.md), so a run in which both legs lost transfers can fail on the Rust leg alone.
